name: Demon God
description: (Tag:dark+)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:infernal+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:social)(Tag:talent)You are the reincarnation of a Demon God. Your Darkness and Unholy abilities and magic below Mythical level gain a tier and cost less energy, your basic physical stats are massively increased, and you can convert your energy directly into a darkness attribute like a Mana Burst. Demonic and infernal beings weaker than you recognize you as absolute authority, while stronger ones still recognize what you are.
